title: Export-Import Executive
summary: An export-import (EXIM) executive handles the trade compliance side of shipping goods in and out of India: customs filings on ICEGATE, DGFT licences such as EPCG, export incentives like RoDTEP and drawback, and letter of credit documents. The role sits in the EXIM, commercial or supply chain team and works with customs brokers, forwarders and banks.
dailyDuties: Check shipping bills and bills of entry filed on ICEGATE
Apply for and track EPCG and Advance Authorisation licences on the DGFT portal
File RoDTEP and duty drawback claims and follow up
Close e-BRC, EDPMS and IDPMS entries with the bank
Prepare and check documents under letters of credit
Coordinate customs brokers, forwarders and shipping lines
Update licence, incentive and shipment trackers

skills.expectation: File and check shipping bills and bills of entry on ICEGATE with the right HS codes and duty
Apply for and close EPCG and Advance Authorisation licences and track export obligation
Claim RoDTEP and duty drawback and follow up until credited
Track export payments and close e-BRC, EDPMS and IDPMS entries with the bank
Prepare and check documents under letters of credit
Prepare invoices, packing lists and certificates of origin under the agreed incoterms
Coordinate customs brokers, freight forwarders and shipping lines
Keep shipment, licence and incentive trackers in Excel
Write clearly to buyers, banks, brokers and government offices
Handle LUT and GST refund paperwork for exports
Update shipment and incentive data in SAP or another ERP
Check freight and clearing bills before payment
Know how forward contracts protect export receivables
